title: A Comprehensive Study of Implicit and Explicit Biases in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates religious bias as one of its primary research targets. It utilizes benchmarks like StereoSet and CrowSPairs to quantitatively measure bias in religion alongside other categories like gender and race, and reports these findings in dedicated rows within its results tables (Tables 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7).
